**AuditLog model (`audit-log.model.ts`):**

- ✅ Omit pattern: `Omit<AuditLog, 'id' | 'createdAt'>`
- ✅ `IAuditLogRepository` with `findByEntity`, `create`, `findAll` — no update method (immutable)
- ✅ `AuditLogValidationError` with code `VALIDATION_ERROR`
- ✅ Uses `Record<string, unknown>` — no `any` types

**Cross-cutting:**
- ✅ TypeScript compiles cleanly (`tsc --noEmit` passes)
- ✅ All 34 existing tests pass
- ✅ No `any` types, no direct DB calls, no hardcoded secrets, no `@gestalt/*` deps
- ✅ No circular dependencies, no cross-module internal imports
